geometry: Preserve the exact square canvas, flat-top hex footprint, camera, scale, deep tapered island, centered recessed front stairs, and transparent padding.
Keep one small circular standing patch in the lower third, horizontally centered immediately above the front stairs.
The standing patch is only large enough for Feastle and remains at the same anchor in every stage.
Allow the kitchen to grow around the standing patch without turning the whole middle into empty floor.
style: Premium cozy stylized 3D toy diorama matching the approved Feastle runtime tile.
Chunky rounded clay-like forms, broad soft bevels, matte simplified materials, low-frequency surfaces, warm diffuse light, and clean silhouettes.
Use Feastle's sage green, terracotta, biscuit cream, honey timber, and amber palette.
Every important feature must remain readable at 256 pixels.
persistentLandmarks: The small rear-left hearth develops into the signature grand community oven without changing its anchor.
The rear-right prep point develops into the main serving counter and remains rear-right.
The upper-left seating point and upper-right refreshment point remain in their respective sides.
The small lower-center character standing patch remains open at every stage.
exclude: standing patch in the vertical center

stages.name: Cold Hearth
stages.narrative: Feastle has found a place to cook, but the old hearth and empty floor cannot yet welcome anyone.
stages.floor: Mostly bare warm terracotta earth with two or three broad worn cream patches and ample unfinished space.
stages.landmark: One tiny unlit cream-stone hearth shell at the rear-left.
props: one empty broad crate at rear-right
one large clay herb pot at upper-left
stages.lighting: Soft neutral daylight with no active hearth glow.
stages.density: Very sparse, practical, and visibly incomplete.

stages.name: First Warm Meal
stages.narrative: A repaired fire and one useful table make the first shared meal possible.
stages.floor: Warm terracotta floor remains dominant with a few broad cream kitchen slabs near the rear.
stages.landmark: The same rear-left hearth is repaired, lit, and gains one rounded chimney.
props: one simple prep table at rear-right
one oversized herb pot at upper-right
stages.lighting: Friendly daylight with a restrained warm hearth glow.
stages.density: A modest first kitchen made from large useful shapes.

stages.name: Working Kitchen
stages.narrative: Feastle establishes a dependable place for preparing food and looking after everyday needs.
stages.floor: Six to eight broad softly beveled terracotta kitchen tiles establish the room while the lower standing patch remains open.
stages.landmark: The rear-left hearth becomes a compact cream-stone oven with terracotta roof and broad arched opening.
props: one serving counter and large soup pot at rear-right
one chunky picnic bench at upper-left
stages.lighting: Soft warm daylight with one oven glow and two broad lantern pools.
stages.density: Clearly established and generous without food clutter.

stages.name: Shared Feast Court
stages.narrative: The kitchen opens into a welcoming table where ordinary meals become moments of connection.
stages.floor: Rich broad terracotta and cream floor masses frame the standing patch without creating a central plaza.
stages.landmark: The same oven grows into a rounded open-air feast kitchen with a wider chimney and warm canopy.
props: a long rounded communal table along the upper-middle edge
stages.lighting: Golden afternoon light with warm oven and lantern glow.
stages.density: Rich and celebratory, composed from a few large readable forms.

stages.name: Grand Community Hearth
stages.narrative: Feastle's home becomes the Haven's definitive gathering place for warmth, nourishment, and celebration.
stages.floor: Polished low-detail terracotta kitchen paving surrounds the small lower standing patch with strong broad color masses.
stages.landmark: The same rear-left oven culminates in a signature grand rounded community hearth with tall terracotta chimney, broad glowing arch, and one oversized herb-leaf emblem without text.
props: a broad curved communal feast table
stages.lighting: Warm celebratory golden daylight with a strong but soft hearth glow.
stages.density: Definitive signature destination with abundance expressed through bold silhouettes, not micro-detail.
